name: Ronoue Genji
source:
Genji is the head butler of Kinzou's mansion. He is the person Kinzou trusts the most.

While it is shown very briefly, Genji is very skilled with knives.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Umineko_no_Naku_Koro_ni_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
